acceptance: Output distinguishes satisfied overrides (for example `OVERRIDE-SATISFIED: <rule> by <file>`) from unsatisfied ones
The summary line counts satisfied and unsatisfied overrides separately
Existing tests are updated and the exit-code contract is unchanged
context: Observed while validating the SSB, ClickBench and TPC-DS overrides for PRs #2602 and #2615 on 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-04.
description: `scripts/validate_submission.py --require-manifest` prints `OVERRIDE-REQUIRED: <rule>` lines and a summary such as `4 override(s) required` even when matching `.override.json` artifacts are present and satisfy every rule. Only the absence of a separate `ERROR: <bundle> requires overrides: <rule>` line shows that the override was accepted. Reviewers confirming override coverage have to remove an override to prove the gate works.
